summary: LLM Wiki ingests only raw files, uses cache hashes for pending work, and records operations in log.md
Reference implementation directories are analysis inputs and are excluded from project verification tooling
Document Mode only accepts Markdown files, surfaces invalid opens, preserves displayPath vs realPath, and disables workspace-only menus
mdx-cli llm-wiki uses the active workspace root for status/ingest/query/digest/lint/search and validates blank input at binary and server boundaries
Mermaid previews must follow @do-md DOMD-Pre rendering, hide generated preview UI from search, and suppress Mermaid-owned error DOM
